verdict.rationale: Lindy documents routines that turn recurring work into hands-off automation: you set a schedule or trigger once and it runs the whole job on autopilot. Background behaviors such as overnight inbox triage, morning briefs and scheduled daily briefs reinforce this, and guardrails govern what Lindy may do without asking. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger types and routine configuration, visibility into run history or failures for background jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
